title: 第二十一章 晋升外门第二十二章 一成都不能信
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
废丹大院里，一道璀璨剑光落下。
一名身穿白袍，面容冷峻的老者，负手出现在废丹大院的废墟之上。
外门执法长老！
三丫认得白袍上的标志，吓得大气不敢喘一声。
他目光淡漠，神识扫过全场。
满地狼藉，战斗痕迹惨烈。
孙管事气息全无，显然已经陨落。
最后，他的目光落在三人身上。
苍老的脸上，并没有过多表情。
“死了这么多人，其他杂役呢，就剩你们三个？”
长老的声音冰冷高远，带着一丝不耐。
他根本不在乎孙管事怎么死的。
在他眼里，废丹房这种地方，死个管事就像死条狗一样正常。
他在乎的是，能不能完成宗门交代的名额。
“咦？”
长老轻咦一声。
他在三人身上都感受到不同程度的灵气波动。
合欢术......嗯？
魔种。
那长老瞥了一眼李狗蛋。

“原来如此，看来孙大为是被你们杀了。”
此话一出，许天三人表情骤然变化。
面对筑基强者，他们生不出要反抗的心。
“尤其是你。”
不在意三人表情变化，长老指了指许天，讶异道：
“杂灵根竟能绝地活下来，且肉身还颇为强悍，有点意思。”
许天连忙低下头，瑟瑟发抖：
“回长老的话......弟子只是命大，饿极吃了些不知名的草......”
“不用谦虚，运气也是实力的一种。”
长老点了点头，不再多问。
翻山宗乃仙道巨擎，一个小辈机缘，身为长老可看不上。
“既已突破炼气，便有资格入我外门。”
长老大袖一挥。
一股不可抗拒力量卷起三人，将他们带上了飞剑。
“走吧。”
“从此以后，你们便是翻山宗外门弟子。”
“至于这里的烂摊子，宗门自会派人来收拾。”
飞剑腾空而起，破开雨幕，直冲云霄。
狂风在耳边呼啸。
这就是仙器吗......

站在剑身下，许天感慨一叹。
content_en:
In the Feidan compound, a bright sword light fell.
An old man wearing a white robe and a stern face appeared on the ruins of the Feidan compound with his hands behind his back.
The outer law enforcement elder!
Sanya recognized the symbol on the white robe and was so frightened that she didn't dare to breathe.
His eyes were indifferent, and his consciousness swept over the whole place.
The ground was in chaos and there were tragic traces of battle.
Manager Sun had no breath at all and had obviously died.
Finally, his eyes fell on the three of them.
There was not much expression on the old face.
"So many people have died. Where are the other handymen, and you three are the only ones left?"
The elder's voice was cold and distant, with a hint of impatience.
He didn't care how Guanshi Sun died.
In his eyes, in a place like Feidanfang, the death of a manager is as normal as the death of a dog.
What he cares about is whether he can fulfill the quota assigned by the sect.
"Huh?"
The elder let out a light sigh.
He felt varying degrees of spiritual energy fluctuations in all three of them.
Acacia Jutsu...huh?
Demonic species.
The elder glanced at Li Goudan.
"I see. It seems that Sun Dawei was killed by you."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of Xu Tian and the others suddenly changed.
Facing a strong foundation builder, they couldn't bear to resist.
"Especially you."
Ignoring the changes in the three people's expressions, the elder pointed at Xu Tian and said in surprise:
"It's interesting that the mixed spirit roots can survive the Jedi, and the body is quite strong."
Xu Tian quickly lowered his head and trembled:
"Replying to the elder...this disciple is just lucky, and he was very hungry and ate some unknown grass..."
"No need to be modest, luck is also a kind of strength."
The elder nodded and asked no more questions.
The Fanshan Sect is a giant in the Immortal Way, and an elder would not look down upon the opportunity given to him by a junior.
"Now that you have broken through Qi Refining, you are qualified to enter my outer sect."
The elder waved his sleeves.
An irresistible force rolled up the three of them and brought them onto the flying sword.
"Let's go."
"From now on, you are the outer disciples of Fanshan Sect."
"As for the mess here, the sect will send people to clean it up."
The flying sword rose into the sky, broke through the rain curtain, and shot straight into the sky.
The wind howled in my ears.
Is this a fairy weapon...
Standing under the sword, Xu Tian sighed.
